patterns.key_values: HUD-style panel (HIG darker-translucent variant), frameless overlay, no traffic lights, transient hold-flick-release invocation; correct per HIG for immersive/transient utility

radial pie-menu launcher: 2 concentric rings (9 app wedges + 7 utility wedges) around a Clear-glass hub with category label + N/M pager; per-wedge icon+label+numbered-badge triad; solid-white aimed-wedge selection; nested sub-wheels via '...'

signature_moves: The wheel as a spatial-memory launcher: fixed wedge positions + hold-flick-release convert app-launch from read-then-click search into motor memory; Fitts best case (huge angular targets from a common origin, acquired by direction not precision)
Solid-white 'aim' selection instead of accent-blue — a reticle/spotlight, deliberately not bound to the system accent, keeping the monochrome system pure
Clear-glass status hub that lenses the live desktop while doubling as category label + '8/9' pager (pager value bolded above its whispered label)
Chroma only from borrowed app icons — the app introduces zero colour of its own; monochrome discipline enforced
Number/letter badges as a parallel expert input path (Tesler): flick to discover, press 1-9/C to accelerate
defects: Contrast Dilution (non-text) — ~1px @10-15% sector dividers below 3:1 (native-audit #10); intentional but firmer dividers would keep calm without failing
Label-over-photography legibility risk — no global backdrop dim; outer labels lean on per-wedge fill + text halo, at risk over light wallpapers (borderline #9)
Label truncation — 'Keep Awak'(e); a magnifier glyph sits beside the 'Volume' label (possible glyph/label mismatch)
Selection deviates from native inset-rounded accent grammar (#3/#6) — reclassified as signature (systematic+purposeful+accessible), logged so the audit reads honestly

aesthetic.direction: Bespoke dark HUD radial-launcher in a committed monochrome system: pure-black/white/silver, zero self-authored chroma, Swiss/neo-grotesque brand voice (heavy grotesk display + grey mono caption). Colour enters only as borrowed app-icon squircles. Not the neo-grotesque-product default look despite the register — the radial pie-menu form and white-reticle selection are genuinely off-distribution for a macOS launcher.
peers: game/DCC radial pie menus (Blender, Maya marking menus)
aesthetic.cluster_hint: monochrome-HUD / spatial-launcher (candidate; synthesis to confirm — pairs with other frameless dark-HUD utilities if any exist in corpus)

psychology: Fitts's Law — radial wedges radiating from a common origin are enormous, roughly-equidistant targets; the flick-release gesture acquires by direction, collapsing pointing distance/precision (best-case target acquisition)

Spatial/motor memory + Jakob's Law inversion — fixed wedge positions let power users flick without reading; deliberately unconventional interface (radial, not a list) betting on learned muscle memory over first-run familiarity
Hick's Law + Miller/Cowan chunking — ~9 items per ring, paged ('8/9') and split into category sub-wheels ('...'), keeping each decision set bounded
Von Restorff effect — the single white-highlighted wedge is the one different thing, which is exactly why one-aim-at-a-time works
Tesler's Law (conservation of complexity) — dual input paths (gesture for discovery, 1-9/C shortcuts for speed) absorb the novice/expert split into the same map
Recognition over recall (partial) — app icons + labels support recognition, but the paid-off end state is pure recall/motor memory of positions
notes: Single UI surface, dark mode only, extracted from the RIGHT ~48% of a 1600x900 marketing composite (left half is brand: glossy orb icon + 'Ten apps. One orb.' grotesk headline + 'Hold Option, flick, release' tagline + 'orbs.studio'). Unknown retina scale and NO standard chrome (traffic lights/titlebar) to calibrate against -> ALL pixel values (estimated), everything (inferred); no canon promotions possible from one app. This is a bespoke radial canvas: cartesian grid checks reinterpreted radially (angular division + concentric rings), and much of the 10-point native-tells audit is N/A (no sidebar/toolbar/window chrome) rather than failing. CROSS-PASS CONTRADICTION for synthesis: the icon pass (orbs-icon.json) classified the app icon as big-sur/legacy baked-Aqua-gloss, but this UI is Liquid-Glass-era (Clear-glass hub) — the brand mark's material lags its own app by an era. To level up Orbs: a real @2x screenshot over a plain/light wallpaper (to test the label legibility risk), a sub-wheel ('...') state, and any settings surface.
